cohort: Singleton births (>28 weeks) at a hospital
finding: The rate of GCMF was 16.4/1000 births, with higher risks observed in unbooked mothers, mothers with low education, gravida 3+, preterm births, and cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of GCMF (4.36%) compared to vaginal delivery (0.62%).
